en-US.longDescription: AstroGrep is a Microsoft Windows grep utility. Grep is a UNIX command-line program which searches within files for keywords. AstroGrep supports regular expressions, versatile printing options, stores most recently used paths and has a "context" feature which is very nice for looking at source code.
en-US.name: AstroGrep

zh-CN.longDescription: AstroGrep 是一款 Microsoft Windows 的 grep 工具。Grep 是一个 UNIX 命令行程序，可在文件中搜索关键字。AstroGrep 支持正则表达式、多种打印选项、存储最近使用的路径，并具有“上下文”功能，非常适合查看源代码。
